hooks: Osric Vane, the Guild steward in the Market Square, pays good coin for steel to clear the orc nest off the cut.
Caldern Voss, a Guild pick at the tin shaft, drinks here when he has copper; he knows the hill and is frightened of what lies under it.
The orcs on the cut sit on goods taken off the valley road; drovers at her tables have lost loads to them.
She is short-handed on busy nights: a guest who lends a hand eats free and hears all the miners' gossip.

concerns.text: Keep the common room full, warm and talking, and her regulars safe while the hills are restless
